title: Scale run
description: Throughput, lag and correctness signals for a scale run, from the metrics the Dusk stack already exports and its tables.

panels.title: Rows of running campaigns
panels.description: Rows of every running or paused campaign, by state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS campaign, n.state, sum(n.count) AS rows FROM campaigns c JOIN campaign_counters n ON n.campaign_id = c.id WHERE c.status IN ('running', 'paused') GROUP BY c.name, n.state ORDER BY c.name, n.state

panels.title: Process results per second
panels.description: Final results in dusk.process_results, by status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, status, count() / $__interval_s AS per_second FROM dusk.process_results WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND status != 'started' GROUP BY t, status ORDER BY t

panels.title: Dispatches per second
panels.description: Campaign processes twilight handed to dawn, by outcome.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t, series, sum(increase) / $__interval_s AS per_second FROM (
  SELECT t, series, instance, greatest(highest - lagInFrame(highest, 1, highest) OVER (PARTITION BY series, instance, attribute_set ORDER BY t), 0) AS increase
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, attributes['outcome'] AS series, resource_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, toString(attributes) AS attribute_set, max(value) AS highest
    FROM dusk.otel_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND service_name = 'twilight' AND metric_name IN ('twilight_dispatch_processes_total', 'twilight_dispatch_processes')
    GROUP BY t, series, instance, attribute_set))
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

panels.title: Calls to dawn per second
panels.description: twilight's requests to dawn, by route and outcome.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t, series, sum(increase) / $__interval_s AS per_second FROM (
  SELECT t, series, instance, greatest(highest - lagInFrame(highest, 1, highest) OVER (PARTITION BY series, instance, attribute_set ORDER BY t), 0) AS increase
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, concat(attributes['route'], ' ', attributes['outcome']) AS series, resource_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, toString(attributes) AS attribute_set, max(value) AS highest
    FROM dusk.otel_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND service_name = 'twilight' AND metric_name IN ('twilight_dawn_requests_total', 'twilight_dawn_requests')
    GROUP BY t, series, instance, attribute_set))
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

panels.title: Call to dawn, mean time
panels.description: Mean time of twilight's requests to dawn, by route.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t, series, sum(added_sum) / nullIf(sum(added_count), 0) AS mean FROM (
  SELECT t, series, instance,
    greatest(highest_sum - lagInFrame(highest_sum, 1, highest_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY series, instance, attribute_set ORDER BY t), 0) AS added_sum,
    greatest(highest_count - lagInFrame(highest_count, 1, highest_count) OVER (PARTITION BY series, instance, attribute_set ORDER BY t), 0) AS added_count
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, attributes['route'] AS series, resource_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, toString(attributes) AS attribute_set, max(sum) AS highest_sum, max(count) AS highest_count
    FROM dusk.otel_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND service_name = 'twilight' AND metric_name = 'twilight_dawn_request_seconds' AND metric_type IN ('histogram', 'summary')
    GROUP BY t, series, instance, attribute_set))
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

panels.title: Postgres connections
panels.description: Connections to the inventory database, by role.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usename AS role, count(*) AS connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'inventory' GROUP BY usename ORDER BY usename

panels.title: Postgres activity
panels.description: Lock requests waiting now, and the inventory database's counters since its statistics were reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted) AS waiting_locks, xact_commit AS commits, xact_rollback AS rollbacks, tup_inserted AS inserted, tup_updated AS updated, tup_deleted AS deleted, deadlocks FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = 'inventory'
